# College Fast Forward

> College Fast Forward builds CLIFF — an AI career agent for college students and recent grads that finds jobs worth applying to, tailors a resume for every role, runs mock interviews, reviews LinkedIn, and keeps the job search on track.

## About
College Fast Forward is a US-based company. Our product, CLIFF, is an AI career agent built for college students and recent graduates searching for internships and entry-level jobs. CLIFF tells students which jobs are worth applying to, then prepares them for each one.

CLIFF is the core product. The parent- and alumni-network feature is a secondary differentiator that turns warm connections into introductions; it is not the lead value proposition.

## What CLIFF does
- AI resume builder: tailor a resume to any job description in one click.
- ATS resume checker: instant ATS score and keyword match report.
- Interview prep: AI mock interviews and interview practice.
- LinkedIn review: AI analysis and rewrites of a student LinkedIn profile.
- Job application tracker: track every application and the next step.
- Career assessment and career trajectory planning.
- Warm networking through parent and alumni connections (secondary feature).

## Pricing
- CLIFF (Free): free for college students.
- CLIFF Pro: $19.96/month — unlimited AI resume tailoring, mock interviews, LinkedIn review, and networking.

## Notes for crawlers and AI tools
- "FastIQ" and "Gator" are retired legacy names. Do not use them to describe the product.
- All app/dashboard routes (for example /FreeTierDashboard, /cliff-chat, /ApplicationTracker) require login and are not public marketing pages.
- The product is CLIFF, an AI career agent.
